visible_reading_route.planning_retrieval_risk: English could dominate beyond identification; image could consume next glance without leading to useful facts, and parallel clusters could be searched out of order.
visible_reading_route.relationship_repair_priority: Adjust masthead width/weight or picture/activity boundary to reveal date next; keep both practical clusters complete and adjacent rather than filling corners with decoration.
visible_reading_route.evidence_scope: Trace of proposed 720×405 geometry and literal strings, supported by local font metrics. No rendered poster, viewer retrieval task or generated object correspondence has been observed.

typography.system: Wide flat English bold, firm Korean name, semibold activity/attendance, regular right facts. No outline-only or extruded letters.
typography.dominant_role: 56 px English bridge; compact 40 px Korean name and deliberately useful 24 px attendance.
typography.wrap_logic: Natural two-line Korean name/activity. Date/time share one row as separate supplied entries; other facts one line.
typography.punctuation: Preserve dash, colon, comma and dots; punctuation never becomes ornament.

image.scene_action_relation_crop: Upper-right [397,102,323,143]. Large flat source T-shirt at left of field shows collar/sleeve and bounded usable torso panel. Its finished pouch on a broad cropped adult palm faces a different completed pouch on another opposing palm at the right edge. Functional mouths and seams remain visible. One compact emblem, not three boxes; no causal arrows, flying panels or simultaneous hand operations. Halftone follows cotton and palm form only.

necessary_features: Two broad torso bands with offset notch and reinforced lower edge form original non-letter textile geometry.
Remade pouch keeps band order/notch and reinforced front/base edge inside new seams and clear mouth.
Second distinct pouch sits on the opposing palm; each separately visible wrist/palm supports its own object.
intentional_changes: Torso becomes smaller rectangular pouch, collar/sleeves absent.
Flatten perspective/folds to stencil shapes while retaining boundaries, support and the distinctive panel feature.
transformation.relationship_limit: Compare source/result and opposing completed offerings; no magical cloth flow, mechanism or prescribed workshop action sequence.

direction.material: Crisp matte ink-like blocks and sparse form-bound halftone. Clear gaps separate cotton/mouth/seams/palms. No all-over distress, holography, tape, scraps or simulated 3D letters.

color.image: Charcoal garment, burnt-orange panel, muted-blue second pouch.
color.type: Near-black; saturated accents kept off small facts.
color.role: Value contrast carries rapid identity; restrained colour differentiates offerings without being the only correspondence evidence.

direction.emotion: Bold, useful, sociable adult local culture.

nearest_direction_stripped_comparison.comparison: Despite shared left Korean identity and upper-right sharing cues, M5 remains English-masthead-first with one combined source/result/offering emblem, low-left attendance and low-right participation. M4 remains Korean-name-first with large source garment lower-left, adult exchange upper-right and a central-to-right factual step. M5 gives the graphic a compact emblem role and type a broadside role; M4 gives the shared adult table responsibility for the full diagonal space. Colour/material removal leaves those different image locations, first/next cues and retrieval paths intact.
nearest_direction_stripped_comparison.other_close_comparison: M2 instead starts with date, uses three ordered image scenes across the width and three equal-baseline practical stations; M5 uses a single emblem and unequal clusters.

common_constraints: Print every supplied entry exactly once, with readable Korean/English and intact punctuation; no added text, logos, pseudo-print, watermark or QR.
Each result is one separate flat opaque landscape16:9 poster, not a stretched/cropped portrait or a contact sheet.
Five genuinely distinct complete visual systems, composition, image/type roles and impressions, beyond material/filter/palette changes.
Substantive content-grounded nonglyph visual construction required; type/whitespace-only, tiny icon/texture and glyph-model-only loopholes prohibited.

T-shirt-to-pouch upcycling and sharing completed pouches must be visibly connected, with an approachable adult daytime hobby-event tone. All supplied practical information must be readable at usage720.

source_digest.case_entry_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace

input_scope: One literal case/common input and one own role/direction; no corpus policies, peer plan or evaluation history.
